note: Part 1 LOGO mid-demo at verify.sh's cycle counts (PAL 12,000,000, NTSC 11,000,000). Re-pinned 2026-09-24 against the real part; the file used to describe the dummy module. The two models are at different frames, so every check states a fact that holds at any phase: the word C64-KB is 55 glyph cells of 3 by 5 plus a 23-cell rule on band row 13, 4,992 white pixels, wobbled right by 1 to 55 pixels and never clipped; the plasma rows run the ramp from black to light green and never reach white; the scroller sprites sit at Y 254 in the opened lower border, which on NTSC wraps into lines 0 to 11 (screenshot rows 235 to 246). Measured on the 2026-09-24 shots: band white 4,991 PAL (one torn line) and 4,992 NTSC; plasma non-black 20,476 and 16,256 PAL, 20,472 and 16,512 NTSC; scroller white 540 PAL, 268 plus 388 NTSC.
